title: This New Jersey road is most haunted street across the country
excerpt: Two New Jersey roads are ranked among the most haunted in the country for their spooky history and paranormal tales. Here's where they are.
content:
Oct. 24, 2026, 4:50 a.m. ET

Haunt enthusiasts looking to explore the scariest roads in the Garden State during the ghoulish days of the season, the state offers two that are nationally ranked.

From ghostly apparitions to unexplained sounds, these roads are known for spine-tingling encounters that defy the ordinary, according to Sixt.com.

The international online mobility services used TikTok and Google search trends to uncover the spookiest streets around the globe for those craving the adrenaline rush of a paranormal encounter.

Out of the 30 roads on the roster, two represents the Garden State with one from Passaic County in the No. 1 spot.

Here's what writes said about the spooky streets of New Jersey:

Clinton Road, New Jersey: No. 1

Said to be haunted by numerous spirits, the infamous Clinton Road is rumored to be home to ghost lights, Dead Man’s Curve, and a ghost boy who returns coins tossed into the river. Travelers may even encounter the Jersey Devil, making this a truly spine-tingling drive. With more than one million searches for Clinton Road in the past year, its reputation as one of the country’s most mysterious roads continues to draw curious travelers.

Clinton Road in New Jersey numbers:

  • more than 260,000 TikTok searches
  • 1,080,000 Google searches

Shades of Death Road, New Jersey: No. 21

Ranked on the list in the No. 21 spot is Shades of Death Road in Warren County. This road is two-lanes and about 6.7 miles that runs alongside of an old haunted lake bed which occasionally has pillars of mist rising from the top of the water. There are many tales of how this road came to be and its infamous names that includes, murder and an outbreak of malaria in the late1800s. Folklore and legends have agreed that this road was the site of many deaths. According to weridnj.com, it appears that the road’s name was offered up as a warning from beyond the grave to those who might travel this dark path unaware of its potential hazards.

10 most haunted roads in the US

These are places where history, mystery, and chilling folklore come together to create spine-tingling experiences for travelers brave enough to explore them, says Sixt.com.

  1. Clinton Road, New Jersey
  2. Kancamagus Highway, New Hampshire
  3. Route 66, California
  4. Route 375 Extraterrestrial Highway, Nevada
  5. Bray Road, Wisconsin
  6. Highway 666, New Mexico
  7. Frontage Road, Montana
  8. Highway 200, North Dakota
  9. Tower Hill Road, Rhode Island
  10. Interstate 4, Florida
